steps.what: Pull personnel records and budget lines
Draft reports and training manuals from fields

loop.output: a report whose numbers match fields and whose pages cite paragraph ids
loop.check: Every amount equals a field and every manual page cites an approved paragraph id
loop.stop: One pass; leave a blank where a field or paragraph id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: The emphasis of a report is not a fixed mail-merge

steps.what: Check reports against the record fields
Sign the records and budgets pack
Maintain the signed records version

tasks.design: Personnel rows in {HCM} and budget lines in {SPREADSHEET} carry record id, period, owner and amount. A bounded draft in {DOCS} writes reports and training-manual pages only from those fields or from paragraphs already approved. The manager checks the figures, signs the pack, and the signed version is the one that is maintained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Records were retyped between the personnel file, the budget sheet and the manual, so a draft could not tell a figure from a guess.
tasks.enabler_now: Record id and amount can be read from the file that already holds them, so commentary can be checked against a field.
tasks.still_hard: What the report should emphasise, and whether a manual page is still true, is still a reading.
tasks.human_edge: The manager signs the pack and stops a page whose number does not match the row.

ambition.what: Sign the record pack on a fixed day each month, not when someone asks

tasks.altitude: Less retyping of records and budgets. The manager keeps the right to reject a report whose figures do not match.

reach.task: Use the signed training manual rather than an old copy
reach.learn: Which manual version is current and which pages are still draft

evidence.claim: Preparing records, reports and manuals is document and spreadsheet work. The meeting share in the prior is high for this task and is not treated as the main means.
Digest [S7] describes document drafting from approved text where a person still checks. A training manual page is not filed until the manager has checked it.
Digest [S15] describes a published report that contained fabricated citations, after which the firm repaid the fee. Commentary is checked against the record rows.

assumptions: Focal role is the community service manager. The task ends at a signed records pack. Deciding pay or eligibility from those records is out of scope.

Input contract: record id, person id, record type, period, amount, owner, approved paragraph id. Producer is the personnel file and the budget sheet. A row with no record id is typed by hand and marked manual.
The prior puts a lot of time in meetings. For this task the time sits on documents, screens and spreadsheets. Use the document store's own templates before custom code.
unknowns: Which training pages have no approved paragraph to draw from.
Who may open another person's personnel record.
research_questions: What share of budget lines is retyped into the report today?
How often does the check find a figure that does not match the row?

already_counted.description: Manager edits weak manual pages in the draft
Figure check stays with the manager

incremental.description: Update report sections when a new record type is added

approvals.approved_version: records pack signed for this period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many rows have no record id, so the manager still retypes. The high case assumes rows are clean but every pack is still checked and signed. The meeting prior is not counted as saved time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Enter referral and complaint fields already known
Assemble the case sheet from entered fields
Conduct the needs evaluation with the client
Decide the child advocacy referral or complaints
Record the complaint decision the manager made

tasks.design: The manager enters case id, person id, need, complaint text and referral reason on {HELPDESK}. A sheet in {DOCS} copies only those fields and leaves a blank where a field is empty. The needs evaluation, the child-advocacy referral and the complaint decision stay in the room. The record stores the decision the manager typed. It does not make one.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case facts were rewritten from memory into a new note for each conversation, so the file and the talk could drift apart.
tasks.enabler_now: The fields the manager already types can be copied into one sheet before the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A referral for a child, a needs judgement and a complaint outcome depend on the person in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the referral, the needs evaluation and the complaint. The sheet does not recommend any of them.
tasks.altitude: The conversations stay. The manager walks in with the fields already entered, and can refuse a sheet that added a recommendation.

reach.task: Attend the needs conversation with the case fields visible
reach.learn: Which fields are on the sheet and which decision is still open

evidence.claim: Direct service of this kind is a conversation. The file can hold what was already said. It cannot decide a referral or a complaint.
Digest [S9] on GDPR article 22 requires a person to decide referrals. There is no solely automated decision about a person.
Digest [S8] describes a hospital incident register where reporting rose, which is more reports and not proof of less harm. A complaint record here is not evidence that harm fell.
Digest [S14] is the Dutch healthcare complaints statute. Its scope is care providers, so it applies only if this organisation is one. The complaint record is still written by a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the community service manager. Child-advocacy referral, needs evaluation and complaint resolution stay with the manager. The machine only assembles fields already entered.
Input contract: case id, person id, need text, complaint text, referral reason, date. Producer is the manager from the conversation or the phone note. Empty fields stay blank and are not inferred.
The meeting prior fits. Use the helpdesk form's own fields before custom code. No recommendation of a referral, a benefit or a complaint outcome is generated.
unknowns: Whether this organisation is a care provider in scope of the complaints statute.
Who may see a child-advocacy case besides the manager.
research_questions: What share of cases is missing a need or a complaint field when the meeting starts?
How often is a referral changed after the conversation?

already_counted.description: Needs evaluation time stays with the manager
Referral and complaint judgement stays in the room

incremental.description: Adjust the case form when a new need type is added

approvals.approved_version: referral or complaint decision signed for this case id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most facts stay verbal until the meeting, so the sheet is sparse. The high case assumes fields are entered first but every evaluation, referral and complaint decision stays manual. No decision about a person is treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Send services the organizations already offer
Draft where community services may be duplicated

loop.input: service rows and the brief template
loop.output: a note that cites organization ids only
loop.check: Every named service has an organization id on the list
loop.stop: One pass; drop any sentence with no organization id
loop.why_not_simpler: Whether two services are the same in practice is not a text match

steps.what: Meet agencies on community needs
Sign the note on duplicated services
File the signed agency note

tasks.design: Agency contacts send organization id, service name and area into {SPREADSHEET}. A bounded note in {DOCS} lists services that may be duplicated and cites those rows only. The manager meets the agencies. A signed note is filed. The list does not replace the relationship.
tasks.previous_blocker: Who offered which service lived in personal notes, so a draft could not show a real overlap.
tasks.enabler_now: Organization id and service name can be stored once and reused before a meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, and whether two services are truly the same, is still a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides whether a service is duplicated and what to ask of the other organization.

ambition.what: Review the service map each quarter for duplication, not only when a clash appears

tasks.altitude: The meetings stay. The manager can open who already offers a service, and can refuse a brief that names an organization not on the list.

reach.task: Confirm the services their organization still offers
reach.learn: Which services this organisation already lists and which look duplicated

evidence.claim: Agency relationships are meetings. A service list can prepare them. It does not keep the relationship.
Digest [S15] describes a published report that contained fabricated citations, after which the firm repaid the fee. A community brief is checked by a person against the service rows.

assumptions: Focal role is the community service manager. The task ends at a signed note after the meeting. Delivering the other agency's service is out of scope.
Input contract: organization id, service name, area, contact name, last meeting date. Producer is the agency contact. A service with no organization id stays off the brief.
The meeting prior fits. Use the spreadsheet's own list before custom code. The manager still attends the meeting.
unknowns: Which agencies will share a service list rather than describe it in the meeting.
Who owns a service that two organizations both claim.
research_questions: How many services on the list have no contact name?
How often does the meeting find a duplication the brief missed?

already_counted.description: Manager edits the duplication brief before the meeting
Meeting time with agencies stays with the manager

incremental.description: Add a service type to the list when a new agency appears
Agency contacts correct a service name the brief rejected

approvals.approved_version: agency note signed after this meeting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes agencies still describe services only in the meeting, so the brief is thin. The high case assumes the list is current but every meeting and the sign-off stay with the manager. Relationship time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit, interview and sign up volunteers

steps.what: Submit details to recruit volunteers
Check application fields for blanks only
Interview volunteers and staff candidates
Decide the hire or volunteer sign-up
Record the volunteer decision on the file

tasks.design: Volunteers submit name, availability, program id and contact on {HELPDESK}. A check marks blank fields only. It does not score the person. The manager interviews and decides the hire or sign-up. {HCM} stores that decision after the manager records it, and {EMAIL} can confirm only that recorded decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications arrived as unstructured mail, so two candidates could not be compared on the same fields without a private ranking.
tasks.enabler_now: The same fields can be required on a form, and a blank can be detected without judging the person.
tasks.still_hard: Whether someone should join, and how the interview felt, is a human decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager interviews and decides. No model score is produced, and the file does not hire on its own.
tasks.altitude: Less time chasing missing fields. The interview and the decision stay with the manager, who can refuse a file that ranked people.

reach.task: Complete the fields and attend the interview
reach.learn: Which fields are still blank and that no score is attached to the application

evidence.claim: Recruiting volunteers is an interview and a decision. A form can collect fields. Ranking people would be a different design and is out of scope.
Digest [S9] on GDPR article 22 says a staff decision must not rest on automation alone, and the person needs a way to contest it. The hire or sign-up here is made by the manager.

assumptions: Focal role is the community service manager. The task ends when the manager's decision is recorded. Onboarding work after sign-up is out of scope.

Input contract: applicant id, name, availability, program id, contact, role sought. Producer is the volunteer. Blank required fields are returned, not guessed. No score, rank or trait label is stored.
The meeting prior fits the interview. Use the helpdesk form's own required fields before custom code. This design does not watch or schedule staff.
unknowns: Who may decide a hire when the manager is away.
Whether staff hiring uses the same form as volunteer sign-up.
research_questions: What share of applications is missing a required field?
How often does the interview overturn the manager's first impression?

already_counted.description: Interview time stays with the manager
Hire or sign-up judgement stays with the manager

incremental.description: Adjust required application fields when a new volunteer role is added
Volunteers fill blanks the form returns

approvals.approved_version: hire or sign-up decision for this applicant id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most applicants still write free-text mail, so the blank check rarely runs. The high case assumes the form is used but every interview and every hire or sign-up stays manual. No scoring of people is treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Record packs are maintained from entered fields. Client meetings, agency conversations and hire decisions stay with the manager.
reach: Clients receive a case sheet of fields already entered, not an automatic referral.
Volunteers receive a sign-up decision only after the manager records it.
skills_to_grow: Keep personnel records and budget reports tied to the fields they came from.
Separate a complaint record from the decision on that complaint.
Interview volunteers without producing a score.
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator can open a current service map, a signed record pack and a volunteer decision without asking the manager to rebuild them.
